title: BCECE Admission Counselling/ Choice Filling 2026
organization: Bihar Combined Entrance Competitive Examination Board
vacancyDetails: Online counselling for UG Engineering, Medical group streams and Agriculture courses under BCECE 2026
qualification: 10+2 with PCM/PCB/PCMB/Agriculture stream + BCECE rank as applicable
applicationFee: Counselling registration fee as per board
selectionProcess: BCECE Exam → Merit → Online Registration & Choice Filling → Seat Allotment → DV
documentsRequired: Photo, signature, educational certificates, photo ID, category certificate if applicable
howToApply:
1. Visit https://bceceboard.bihar.gov.in
2. Open BCECE-JOINT counselling notice
3. Register on online counselling portal
4. Fill and lock college/course choices
5. Download allotment letter and report
shortDescription: BCECE Admission Counselling / Choice Filling 2026 for PCM/PCB/PCMB & Agriculture groups on bceceboard.bihar.gov.in.
content:
BCECEB has issued notices for online counselling of BCECE-JOINT [PCM/PCB/PCMB] and Agriculture groups 2026.

Qualified candidates must complete registration, choice filling and fee payment as per the published schedule on bceceboard.bihar.gov.in.
